kpis.short: Acquisition Sandstorm Gold et Horizon Copper
kpis.name: Sandstorm Gold and Horizon Copper Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of Sandstorm Gold and Horizon Copper streaming and royalty portfolio
kpis.description: Acquisition of all issued shares of Sandstorm Gold Ltd. and Horizon Copper Corp. for $4.148 billion, completed October 20, 2025. Royal Gold issued 18.6 million shares and assumed options for 0.7 million shares, and paid $380.9 million in cash to repay Sandstorm's credit facility debt

kpis.name: Kansanshi Gold Stream Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of gold stream on Kansanshi copper-gold mine in Zambia
kpis.description: Royal Gold made $1.0 billion upfront payment for a gold stream on the Kansanshi copper-gold mine in Zambia on August 5, 2025. The stream includes 75 ounces of gold per million pounds of copper recovered up to 425,000 ounces, then declining rates. Royal Gold will pay 20% of spot gold price, or 35% after certain credit rating thresholds are met
kpis.signal: Major gold stream advance announced August 5, 2025

kpis.name: Warintza Gold Stream and Royalty Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Acquisition of gold stream and royalty on Warintza project in Ecuador
kpis.description: Royal Gold acquired a gold stream and net smelter return royalty on all metals from the Warintza project in Ecuador for $200 million in cash. Staggered payments: $100M at closing, $50M after environmental approval and pre-feasibility study publication (Q1 2026), and $50M one year after closing
kpis.signal: Gold stream and metals royalty acquisition May 21, 2025

risks.title: Metal price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk placed first in 10-K, with strong language emphasizing direct impact on revenues and cash flows. Gold price dependence is explicit. Highly weighted Macro category.

risks.title: Concentration in key projects
risks.score_rationale: 53% of revenues from five projects. Text emphasizes disproportionate impact of issues at major sites. Central position in document.

risks.title: Lack of operational control
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeated multiple times with concerning language on inability to influence operator decisions. Direct impact on investment profitability.

risks.title: Limited access to project data
risks.score_rationale: Lack of data access presented as major obstacle to reserve verification and regulatory disclosure. Strong language on misinformation risks.

risks.title: Acquisition-related risks
risks.score_rationale: Multiple paragraphs detail integration, overvaluation, and internal control risks post-acquisition. References to recent Sandstorm and Horizon acquisitions.

risks.title: Key person dependence
risks.score_rationale: Risk clearly stated, especially on potential loss of executives or directors. No life insurance in place. Less central than other risks.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT threats
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned with concrete examples (ransomware, intrusions), though text is truncated. Lower weight than business risks, but present in context of external system dependence.

ai_positioning.summary: RGLD does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
